summary: A NIFTY future at Quote takes the market and OI topics; its OI packet is held for the next market packet. A Depth 20 subscribe (acknowledged as 5) moves it to Depth by subscribing both topics again, keeping the OI it holds; the Depth holder leaving does the same.

notes: The web keeps one stream at the highest mode and keeps its OI cache across mode changes (iiflcapital_adapter.py:307-330).

deviations.reason: The web passes IIFL's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
